STANZA I
Saints, at your Father's heavenly word
Give up your comforts to the Lord;
He shall restore what you resign,
Or grant you blessings more divine.
No line of this stanza quotes a verse closely; it is the hymn's own confession.
Where Watts found it
Watts printed the hymn under Genesis 22:6. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering and placed it on his son Isaac. He himself carried the fire and the sacrificial knife, and the two of them walked on together. GENESIS 22:6 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ GENESIS 22
So Abraham with obedient hand, Led forth his son at God's command, The wood, the fire, the knife he took, His arm prepar'd the dreadful stroke. STANZA II
